decisions.decision_reason: 17M standalone AllTracker-based video point tracking finetuned on robot manipulation; 66MB original full checkpoint, independent learned state, distinct role from robot control/VLM. Model card Apache2 and code Apache/MIT but individual rights/runtime still unverified.
decisions.negative_evidence: Author RoboTAP AJ 68.41 vs original AllTracker68.48 (slightly worse); one checkpoint only, no local owner benchmark; no model license file in 3-file HF repo, only card + code root/license; weights are potentially unsafe pickle PTH and must never auto-import.
prerequisites: Owner explicit intended legal acts rights and Apache+vendored MIT review
Vendor Python runtime code static review
PyTorch torch.load(weights_only=True) pinned source and safe local path, no auto network
Full offline restore from exactly pinned source
Actual Windows D headroom >=200GB after staging/cache

decisions.decision_reason: ~1B independently finetuned VGGT CoWTracker source, 3.899GB checkpoint, distinct training from 17M; not interchangeable with small AllTracker model.
decisions.negative_evidence: CC BY-NC 4.0 model weight, external FAIR Noncommercial Research License CoWTracker fork, original self-eval, author H200 GPU ~47GB and 18fps, owner GPU/clock/batch unknown. Cannot call it unrestricted or treat it as source equivalent to RoboTracker.
prerequisites: CoWTracker custom dependencies + VGGT and DepthAnything-V2 submodules frozen
Torch==2.10.0 torchvision==0.25.0 xformers==0.0.34 and python/driver owner ABI
Owner GPU peak, privacy/robot-control physical safety
Exact local model SHA and offline restore, explicit owner approval

H_T_D_C_U.H: The small 17M full finetuned point-tracker checkpoint preserves an independently learned robotics perception role not covered by existing generic VLM/robot policies, at 66MB plus 165KB of lean code; the larger 1B Warp has unique higher quality but incompatible NC and GPU constraints.
H_T_D_C_U.T: Pin each publisher three-file model repo at immutable SHA, all Git blob OIDs and LFS SHA, verify original AllTracker LFS SHA differs, code repository tree 56 blobs and 19 lean blobs, license tags and dataset reference commits. Next evaluate >=100 independent tracking clips and 30 throughput repeats on same HW/clock/batch/resolution, then owner legal/disk/offline checks.
H_T_D_C_U.D: STATIC PASS if 6 model files, 56 code blob hashes, parent weight difference and noncommercial rights gates match; FULL DOWNLOAD STOP without owner licensed act, local SHA, batch/context backend and explicit source manifest approval; model code/PTH security must PASS before execute.
H_T_D_C_U.C: Publisher 0.84 AJ improvement is small and RoboTAP is slightly worse, demonstrating limited generalization. External OpenCV/CUDA/AllTracker code might be incompatible; no H200/owner GPU for Warp; rights and benchmark videos may block true offline study.
H_T_D_C_U.U: Self-eval benchmark and unclear clocks, 17M author param estimate from PTH not independently counted, noncomm code, hardware, D free space, and dataset privacy unverified. No repeated owner measurements to estimate u_c/k.

interdisciplinary: robotics perception and video point tracking
statistical validation of held-out benchmark generalization
